verdict.rationale: Ramp's Applications API lets a partner "pre-fill a Ramp application on behalf of a new business" and obtain OAuth API access to that business's account, effectively letting a developer stand up Ramp-backed (bank-partnered, FDIC-insured via First Internet Bank) banking/checking accounts for their customers without holding a banking license themselves, and the Banking API/Treasury docs show the account and balance surfaces available. However this is explicitly a partner-gated program (not self-serve), incorporation/company-formation is described as private-preview only, and there's no evidence of white-labeling or a dedicated 'embedded banking for your customers' BaaS product story beyond this partner application flow. Missing for 10: public self-serve enrollment for embedded banking (vs. partner-only gating), explicit white-label/branding support, and independent confirmation of end-customer-facing account issuance at scale.
